description_zh: 调用UpdateAlertContact接口更新报警联系人
name: UpdateAlertContact

parameters.help_en: The new name of the alert contact
parameters.help_zh: 将报警联系人名称改为此名称
parameters.name: contact_name

parameters.help_en:
The new mobile phone number of the alert contact. You must specify at least one of the following parameters: PhoneNum, Email, and DingRobotWebhookUrl.

If you do not specify this parameter, the original parameter value is deleted. If you specify this parameter, the original parameter value is updated
parameters.help_zh:
将报警联系人的手机号码修改为此值。PhoneNum、Email和DingRobotWebhookUrl必须至少填写一个。

如果此参数为空，则表示删除报警联系人的该参数。如果此参数设为一个值，则表示更新报警联系人的该参数
parameters.name: phone_num

parameters.help_en:
The new email address of the alert contact. You must specify at least one of the following parameters: PhoneNum, Email, and DingRobotWebhookUrl.

If you do not specify this parameter, the original parameter value is deleted. If you specify this parameter, the original parameter value is updated
parameters.help_zh:
将报警联系人的邮箱地址修改为此值。PhoneNum、Email和DingRobotWebhookUrl必须至少填写一个。

如果此参数为空，则表示删除报警联系人的该参数。如果此参数设为一个值，则表示更新报警联系人的该参数
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
The new webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106247.html. You must specify at least one of the following parameters: PhoneNum, Email, and DingRobotWebhookUrl.

If you do not specify this parameter, the original parameter value is deleted. If you specify this parameter, the original parameter value is updated
parameters.help_zh:
将报警联系人的钉钉机器人Webhook URL修改为此值，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106247.html。PhoneNum、Email和DingRobotWebhookUrl必须至少填写一个。

如果此参数为空，则表示删除报警联系人的该参数。如果此参数设为一个值，则表示更新报警联系人的该参数
parameters.name: ding_robot_webhook_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the alert contact receives system notifications. Valid values:

`true`: The alert contact receives system notifications.
`false`: The alert contact does not receive system notifications
parameters.help_zh:
是否接收系统通知：

`true`：接收系统通知
`false`：不接收系统通知
parameters.name: system_noc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. Set the value to `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert contact to be updated. You can call the SearchAlertContact operation to query the contact ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130703.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要更新的报警联系人的ID，可调用SearchAlertContact接口来查询，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130703.html
parameters.name: contact_id

IsSuccess.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert contact was updated. Valid values:

true: The alert contact was updated.
false: The alert contact failed to be updated
IsSuccess.description_zh:
更新联系人是否成功：

true：更新成功
false：更新失败
